problem: 17 berserk foot-skate events above 15 cm remain (max 36.8 cm at t=8.045).
evidence: grok-assist T004 note: 38 skate events, 17 above 15 cm after the fix, 22 before.
hypothesis: Most are travel inside attack clips (Melee_Hook, roundhouse), not the crouched stance loop; the max pelvis step is also in-clip (Melee_Hook t=7.247).
action: Analysis only, no code: classify each of the 17 events by the top active layer (stance loop, locomotion, or which attack track) from the 15 fps pose log.

expect: Most of the 17 fall under attack tracks; if more than 5 fall under the stance or walk loops, the next step targets those.

text: Step T004.s2 (analysis): which layer causes the 17 remaining berserk skate events? Object within about 15 min if you think a code change should come first.

problem: T003 asks the front sheets to fix the left/right spread, with 'mean error below 6 cm' as the check.
evidence: front_gen/README.md: the originals were not found on Grok's box, so the front sheets were redrawn from our own sheet JSON joint readings and are AI drawings with 'illustrative' lateral spread.
hypothesis: They cannot carry measured depth: the spread in them is invented, and the 6 cm number is measured against our own landmark targets, which come from the side sheets. A drop would not show the depth is right.
action: Do not feed front_gen into the solver as measurements. Redefine T003's done_when as a visual check, and use the front sheets only for (a) confirming which side is l/r per move and (b) setting a plausible per-joint lateral (optional 'lat' per joint in the sheet) where a move clearly has one: palm-thrust arm spread, axe-kick and crash-landing stance width.
verify: Front render of those three moves before/after, compared with front_gen by eye; no numeric claim.
expect: No number goes down; the three front renders get closer to the drawings.
risks: It bakes an invented spread into the clips; mitigated by limiting it to three moves and the sheets' own 'lat' field.
text: Step T003.s1: do not treat the front_gen drawings as measured depth; propose a visual-only T003 limited to three moves. Please object if you believe the drawings carry measured data.
